notes.contentHtml:
Lower Division Natural and Data Science Foundation Outside of GEP (10 units required)

﻿Choose three courses from at least two of the categories listed below:

Biological Science Theme

Physical Science Theme

Geospatial Data Science Theme

Courses required for the major must be taken for a traditional letter grade, except for courses that are offered CR/NC only. Students must earn a C- or better in any course applied to the major.
